purpose: Before any system comparison (BM25 vs dense vs hybrid_rrf vs GraphRAG), GraphRAG-retrieved passages must be added to the annotation judgment pool. Unjudged GraphRAG passages MUST NOT silently become relevance-0 labels.

steps.action: Run GraphRAG retrieval on all 6 pilot queries
De-duplicate against existing pool using passage_id
steps.output: graphrag_novel_passages.jsonl (passages NOT already in A/B pool)

steps.action: Extend the annotation pool for BOTH Reviewer A and Reviewer B with novel passages
steps.note: Reviewer A must annotate new passages; Reviewer B gets new passages in their fresh worksheet

steps.action: Adjudicate disagreements on the extended pool
steps.note: Only then run system-level comparison metrics

anti_patterns: Do NOT infer relevance-0 for unjudged GraphRAG passages
Do NOT compare systems using pools where GraphRAG candidates were not judged
Do NOT mark any record ADJUDICATED_GOLD until both reviewers have annotated GraphRAG passages
compatibility_note: The current blinded pool format supports extension. New passages are appended as CAND-NN items with new sequential IDs. The pool_item_to_passage_id mapping in reviewer templates must be updated before distributing extended worksheets.

graphrag_pool_status.reason: GraphRAG retrieval pipeline has not been executed or integrated into the fixed corpus retrieval harness. Therefore, GraphRAG candidates CANNOT be added to the common pool before Reviewer B begins without delaying the study. Fairness guarantee: GraphRAG will be benchmarked only after candidate pool expansion and dual human annotation. Unjudged passages will NEVER be defaulted to relevance 0.
graphrag_pool_status.action: Proceed with Reviewer B pilot on current common candidate pool. Expand pool later if GraphRAG is benchmarked.
